Thank you for your kind feedback.

We will continue to strive to provide thorough examinations and clear explanations, aiming to become an even better animal hospital. Thank you for your continued support.

It's been a year since I adopted my rescue dog, and since then, I've been relying on Matsubara Pet Clinic for everything, including grooming.

Dr. Iwatomi, the clinic director, patiently explains things even to first-time pet owners, and all the staff are kind and you can really feel their deep love for animals. Their Instagram is also fun to look at.

I gave it 4 stars because I can't compare it to other clinics.

Thank you for your kind feedback.

I will continue to treat patients and provide explanations with the same care and attention I would give to my own family.

Thank you for your review.

Because they always explain things so carefully, I also asked them to perform the spaying surgery on my 7-month-old puppy. I picked her up two days after the surgery, and she didn't seem to be in any pain, and the incision looks like it will heal very nicely. I'm so glad I entrusted her to them!

I am very grateful for the kind and thorough examinations I always receive.
I feel reassured knowing that no matter what happens, I can go to the doctor and everything will be alright.

My elderly cat had cystitis and I was giving her medication prescribed by another hospital, but it quickly recurred.

I decided to have her examined at this hospital, and the doctor explained everything very carefully, so I now understand her current condition well.

She seems to be in better condition and is moving around more than she did a month ago.

Thanks to you, we can spend the New Year together. Thank you.

Thank you for your high rating.
We will continue to work hard together with our staff to ensure pet owners are satisfied.
We appreciate your continued support.
We have been going there for a long time. The doctor and all the staff are kind and caring. It is a reliable clinic.

The veterinary clinic we used to go to changed management, and our cat's health didn't improve, so we tried several other clinics before finally finding this one! The doctor here is exactly what we were looking for; he treats animals with great love and care, not just providing data and numbers from tests, but also performing physical examinations and visually checking their entire bodies. He also gives precise advice on even the smallest questions, and his personality is truly wonderful. Our two cats' health has steadily improved, the one who was initially ill is now completely recovered, and the other one, who had sudden cystitis, is much better. The reception staff and nurses are also very friendly and helpful, and we've become such big fans that we wouldn't consider any other clinic! Incidentally, I recently learned that a classmate's dog has been a long-time patient at this clinic, which confirmed my belief that it's the right choice (lol). If you're undecided about which veterinary clinic to choose, I highly recommend you give this one a try.

We have been taking care of our Corgis for three generations since 1999. Their surgical and other procedures are very meticulous, and they have saved our first and second Corgis many times. We can entrust our dogs to them with complete confidence. The fact that they are open on Saturdays from 4pm to 7pm is a great help for working families. The doctor and staff treat animals with kindness and are happy to answer any questions we may have.

Thank you for your kind feedback.

We will continue to work hard to ensure the happiness of your animals and the smiles of their owners, while carefully addressing any concerns, anxieties, or questions you may have. Thank you for your continued support.

My cat, who will be 15 this year, has been receiving treatment here for over 5 years.

The doctor's examinations are very sincere and accurate, and I feel a sense of kindness in how he treats each patient with care.

The nurses are all kind and funny too.

She's had several surgeries, but thanks to everyone, she's still healthy at 15 years old.

Even though we've moved away from this town, I still take the bus to come here.

I've never had a bad experience visiting this clinic.
He's a great teacher who is very caring and attentive.
The nurses who take care of me are quitting one after another.

Thank you for your high rating.
We will continue to strive to help your little family stay healthy.
Please continue to support us.
